label: Action buttons under the bar
description: Up to four buttons that fill the prompt box when they make sense; nothing is ever sent

label: Say when it is your turn
description: The strip says your turn while a question or an approval is open

label: Bar animations
description: The sweep while working and the finishing effects (motion off and calm still win)

label: Remember command times
description: Keep the first words and duration of slow commands to estimate the next run

label: Count background tasks
description: Count what is still running when a turn stops

label: A layout per project
description: Remember the bar's layout for each folder; off keeps one layout everywhere

label: Allow hiding while typing
description: Lets the hide while typing item work (the item itself is off until chosen)
